subtitles.text: You'd think after making it this far, they'd stop underestimating the foreigner.
It wouldn't be so annoying if he wasn't so damn pretty.
Nah, way too fake for me.
Such patience...
Total wimp, just like you. But it gets you guys the W.
That other loser's toast.
He should have already thrown in the towel, but doesn't even know it yet.
Good job out there.
Thanks. Yeah, the walls held out.
Haven't yet watched your replay, but will be sure to tonight.
Yeah, please ignore the ugly style.
I also won by defense though,
but for most of the game it just looks like I'm running scared.
Patience often does, until you win. Hey, do you want to get tea later?
I'll be at the courtyard in about a longhour.
Sure, yeah, that works well for me!
Great, I'll see you then. Bai, you're welcome to come too.
Hope to see you there!
See you. So are you gonna come? Should be fun!
He's your competition, remember?
Take it easy, you're my competition too.
'Was.' And you know I hate you. And I know all your tricks already anyway.
We don't know anything about this guy.
So let's get to know him, it'll be fun! Maybe he won't be so fake after all.
Hey, over here! We were just talking about you!
jie mo kai tu jie hei ja ma?
Whoa
What is it?
I think these are some of the new symbols that they're A/B testing for the
Dzegoban version nine.
Have you heard about version nine?
I had a couple people mention it to me. Making the language visual.
Hmmm.
More straight horizontal lines than usual,
and the three diagonal lines on the right. probably pronunciation markers?
Top right is 'kai', right?
The extra vertical vein on the left is unusual,
although I'm not sure I would make the images so detailed when they have such
different meanings, depending on the context.
Wait, you know Dzegoban?
Zei, the whole point of Dzegoban is that you can learn it in less than a month.
I'm impressed, you're almost a local already.
Actually, I don't think I want anything. Plus, I've got a lot to catch up on.
Zei, when you're done, come get me. I want to go over some things with you.
So while visiting, I've been wondering about the differences between home and
here. And I've been wondering, why does Dzego like Minpentai so much?
Kids get into it pretty young here, I guess.
Whole family involved, it's a big thing.
One of our quirks, just like the language. Does Redshire have any quirks?
Sure. Yeah, we have our fair share.
We care a lot about natural beauty,
and maybe have an unnatural obsession with old styles.
Less cameras, more castles, that kind of thing.
I see where you get your love of walls then.
Yes. Simple, straightforward, useful.
Why don't you come visit?
My parents just told me I need to come back for an early birthday celebration
for them, so you can come with me!
Well, budget will be pretty tight for... about fifteen days.
Oh yeah, then I can use some of my winnings to pay for your trip, right?
You're welcome to come too, Bai!
What?!! Dreadnaught!! It's good! You should check it out.
Dze go ba fau gie
